_doc: Registry of QA checks. severity: hard = files a GitHub issue (once QA_REPORT_ONLY is off), soft = weekly summary only. born_from = the real incident that created the check (rule: every manually found defect becomes a check + a fixture, see CLAUDE.md).

web.status.born_from: Q0 baseline: any sitemap URL or internal link that is not a clean 200 (the 'unpublish never gated the site' class, 2026-09-03)
web.status.what: HTTP status != 200 for a sitemap URL, redirect chain > 2, or a broken internal link

web.console.born_from: /today Tonight/Tomorrow script dead in production since Fas 1 (2026-10-21)
web.console.what: console.error, uncaught page error or failed first-party request

web.duplicate-content.born_from: University digest finding 2026-10-23: /university/ showed the long digest text as cards and the digest page showed the same text again (list vs detail). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_duplicate_university_2026-10-23.json
web.duplicate-content.what: a page is mostly (> 60 %, 8-word shingles, pages >= 300 chars) made of text already on a page that links to it; BOTH pages are flagged

q3.pair-review.born_from: University digest finding 2026-10-23 (list vs detail page); weekly AI review of list + detail pair: does the detail page add anything the list lacks, and does old content take too much room
q3.pair-review.what: AI review of a list page and its detail page side by side (qa/q3)

web.literal.born_from: Q0 baseline (spec item: undefined/NaN/null/--); extended 2026-10-23 after a stray ')}' showed under the navigation on every page for two days (leftover '</nav> )}' in BaseLayout.astro; the header is outside <main>, so the check now also reads shellText). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_literal_stray_header_2026-10-23.html
web.literal.what: visible 'undefined', 'NaN', 'null', '[object Object]', 'Invalid Date', '{{', '}}', '${', ')}' or a lone '--', in <main> or in the page shell (header, nav, footer)

web.title-dup.what: the same <title> on more than one URL in a run

web.leak.born_from: culture essay on moreno_valley_ca that belonged to Brookings (2026-08, see CONTAMINATION_REPORT.md)
web.leak.what: another town's identity term (ai_pipeline/town_guard.py HARD_BLOCKLIST) in <main>, title, meta description or img alt

ops.scrape-liveness.born_from: GitHub cron started scrapes 4.5-9.5 h late; Cloudflare cron-dispatcher + watchdog (Kö 9 Steg 1, 2026-10-21)
ops.scrape-liveness.what: a town has had no successful scrape_runs row for 26 h

ops.qa-liveness.born_from: 2026-10-28: qa/web/run.mjs had a syntax error from 2026-10-24 and no QA ran for four days without anything complaining; watchdog scripts/check_qa_liveness.py on GitHub's own schedule
ops.qa-liveness.what: qa-daily has not finished green for 30 h

ops.sport-freshness.born_from: 2026-11-08: the cron-dispatcher's weather/warnings/sports jobs failed only in Cloudflare's logs, which nobody reads; scripts/check_freshness.py on GitHub's own schedule opens an issue instead
ops.sport-freshness.what: an active sports source has had no successful run in sport_sources_health for 26 h

ops.sport-warning.born_from: 2026-11-09: a sport page that keeps failing is skipped while the other sports are written (sports/http.py retry + page isolation), so last_success stays fresh and ops.sport-freshness cannot see it; the warning in sport_sources_health.last_error is the only sign
ops.sport-warning.what: the same `warning:` has been in sport_sources_health.last_error for more than 3 days

ops.weather-freshness.born_from: 2026-11-08: the cron-dispatcher's weather/warnings/sports jobs failed only in Cloudflare's logs, which nobody reads; scripts/check_freshness.py on GitHub's own schedule opens an issue instead
ops.weather-freshness.what: a town's newest weather_snapshots payload.fetched_at is older than 3 h

ops.alerts-freshness.born_from: 2026-11-08: the cron-dispatcher's weather/warnings/sports jobs failed only in Cloudflare's logs, which nobody reads; scripts/check_freshness.py on GitHub's own schedule opens an issue instead
ops.alerts-freshness.what: a town's NWS/Met Office warnings fetch (dispatcher_heartbeat job 'alerts') has not succeeded for 2 h

ops.safety-freshness.born_from: 2026-11-08: the cron-dispatcher's weather/warnings/sports jobs failed only in Cloudflare's logs, which nobody reads; scripts/check_freshness.py on GitHub's own schedule opens an issue instead
ops.safety-freshness.what: a town's wildfire/air-quality fetch (dispatcher_heartbeat job 'safety') has not succeeded for 3 h

ops.evening-register-freshness.born_from: 2026-11-08: the register's dated rules lapsed on 11-05 (first run on a Thursday, the Monday run skipped its venues as checked <6 days ago) and Broomfield's register has valid rules for 1 of 7 venues; nothing watched it. Owner minimums: Glasgow 4, Broomfield 1
ops.evening-register-freshness.what: a town's evening register has fewer venues with a valid rule than its minimum (dated 8 days, recurring 36), or no venue check for 9 days

ops.token-expiry.born_from: 2026-11-08: the cron-dispatcher's weather/warnings/sports jobs failed only in Cloudflare's logs, which nobody reads; scripts/check_freshness.py on GitHub's own schedule opens an issue instead
ops.token-expiry.what: the cron-dispatcher's GITHUB_TOKEN expires within 30 days (TOKEN_EXPIRES in scripts/check_freshness.py)

qa.tracking.born_from: QA must never count as a visitor (owner requirement 2026-10-21)
qa.tracking.what: page tried to load analytics/ads scripts although QA declined consent (they were aborted)

web.axe.born_from: Fas 6 dark mode contrast work (2026-10-21) -- contrast regressions found by eye
web.axe.what: axe WCAG A/AA violation with impact serious/critical, in light or dark, desktop or mobile (key pages)

web.axe-minor.what: axe WCAG A/AA violation with impact minor/moderate

web.empty.born_from: Broomfield /this-week empty (events table only had NWS alerts, 2026-10); extended 2026-10-24 after Glasgow /events/ kept an empty TODAY heading once its only card had ended (the probe counted hidden cards' links as content). Regression: site/src/lib/hide-ended.test.ts

web.clientfill.born_from: /today Tonight/Tomorrow never filled on any town from Fas 1 to 2026-10-21 (:scope on template fragment; Broomfield lost the bucket script)
web.clientfill.what: client-rendered bucket still empty although the template holds events and there is no 'nothing scheduled' note

web.stale-alert.born_from: expired weather/closure alerts kept showing (Time/alerts handoff Phase 1, 2026-10-20)
web.stale-alert.what: element with data-ends in the past that is still visible (real clock and the 07:00/19:00/23:30 clock passes)

web.stale-recently.born_from: 2026-10-24 owner: Glasgow /events/ showed recurring series under "Recently" with the date they were first seen (JUN 2, FEB 22, NOV 27); fixed in db.ts getPastStories + publish.py series refresh. Regression: site/src/lib/db.test.ts, tests/test_events_grouping.py, site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts
web.stale-recently.what: a card under the "Recently" heading whose start is more than 90 days before the page clock

web.past-event.born_from: passed events shown under Today/Tonight (Time/alerts handoff)
web.past-event.what: event in the Tonight bucket that is over (or not today), or in Tomorrow that is not tomorrow, at the page's clock

web.extlink.born_from: Q1: external links checked weekly only (load reduction)
web.extlink.what: external link answering 4xx/5xx (401/403/429 ignored as bot walls) or unreachable

web.routes.born_from: 2026-10-28 owner: live /ads.txt answered 200 with the body "Not found" (public/ads.txt collided with the ads.txt.ts route) and /advertise had no redirect to /advertising/; fixed in astro.config.mjs (ads.txt only for the town with a publisher id) and server/worker.ts; regression fixtures in site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts (routeFindings)
web.routes.what: /ads.txt answers 200 without a valid record, or anything but 404/200; /advertise is not a 301 to /advertising/

web.allday-clock.born_from: 2026-10-22 owner: all-day events (e.g. 114th Hobo Day, start 00:00 local, no end) rendered as "12:00 AM"; fixed with lib/local-day.ts isAllDay; regression tests in local-day/time/db test files
web.allday-clock.what: An event element with a local-midnight start and no real end whose visible time label shows 12 AM instead of "All day"

evening.index-gate.born_from: Owner 2026-10-28/29: /tonight and /this-weekend stay noindex until the owner says yes (weekend-layer.md, 'Före indexering'). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.index-gate.what: an evening page has no noindex while its path is not in qa/evening-index-approved.json

evening.summary-count.born_from: Step-7 review 2026-10-29: after the browser re-count /tonight said '24 things on tonight' with 12 tonight and 12 tomorrow night (countVisibleThings counted every day). Fixed in evening-client.ts (firstDayOnly). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.summary-count.what: the 'N things on tonight' line differs from the entries shown in the first day section

evening.open-late-wording.born_from: Step-7 review 2026-10-29: Open late rows read 'Pub, closes until 3am' (the time was said twice, 'closes until' is wrong English). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.open-late-wording.what: an Open late row meta contains 'closes until' or 'closes open'

evening.group-misfit.born_from: Owner 2026-10-29: Essy Sparrow, a singer at SWG3 at 7 pm, was listed under Clubs & late (settleGroup in evening-items.ts now demands start >= 22:00 or a club word). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.group-misfit.what: a row under Clubs & late starts between 05:00 and 22:00 local without a club word in its title

evening.dup-row.born_from: Evening layer step 3 (dedup across sources: same start + overlapping title); guard against the same event listed from two sources, and an Open late place listed twice. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.dup-row.what: the same start + title twice on a page, or an Open late place twice in a day

evening.row-source.born_from: weekend-layer.md Skydd punkt 4: every row carries a source link. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.row-source.what: a card or row without a link

evening.ended-row.born_from: Time/alerts handoff (web.past-event covers /today only); Pass E loads the evening pages with the clock at 19:00 and 23:30. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.ended-row.what: a visible row that started more than 3 h ago (or past its end)

evening.order.born_from: Evening layer design pass: rows inside a group are sorted by start. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.order.what: rows in a group are not in start order

evening.stale-read.born_from: weekend-layer.md Skydd punkt 4 + GETTING_HOME_MAX_AGE_DAYS: sources 'read <date>' older than 3 days means the page was not rebuilt; Getting home 'Checked <date>' older than 30 days. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
evening.stale-read.what: the About text carries a read/Checked date that is too old

evening.sources.born_from: weekend-layer.md Skydd punkt 4/5: the 'How we gather this' text must exist (source, date, what is estimated). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).

evening.garbled-title.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29 on Broomfield /tonight: Ticketmaster's own data had 'Tim Burton???s' and 'D??a de Muertos' (cleanTicketmasterTitle in ticketmaster.ts repairs it). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.
evening.garbled-title.what: a card or row title contains two or more question marks in a row (soft: it is Ticketmaster's own data; only the apostrophe pattern is repaired, owner 2026-10-29)

evening.allcaps-title.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29: titles in capitals ('MAMA TERRA', 'NOAHFINNCE'); owner: show ordinary capitalisation, keep known abbreviations (displayTitle in evening-names.ts). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.
evening.allcaps-title.what: a card or row title is entirely in capitals and is not a known abbreviation

evening.tour-listing.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29: 'KSE Venue Ball Arena Tours' (a guided building tour) led the Broomfield marquee; owner: filter tours (isVenueTourTitle in ticketmaster.ts). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.

evening.venue-spelling.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29: 'Oran Mor' (Ticketmaster) beside 'Òran Mór' (OpenStreetMap); owner: canonical venue list (src/config/venue-names.json). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.
evening.venue-spelling.what: the same venue appears with two spellings on one page

evening.free-claim.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29: the page text promised 'what is free' while no Free label was shown; owner: say it only when Free items exist. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.
evening.free-claim.what: the About text claims to show what is free but no Free label or group is visible

evening.weekend-forecast.born_from: Q3 2026-10-29: /this-weekend showed Thursday's weather; owner: forecast Friday to Sunday (weekendForecastLine). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_evening_2026-10-29.json.
evening.weekend-forecast.what: the /this-weekend weather line does not mention Friday, Saturday or Sunday

safety.crime-word.born_from: Public-safety plan 2026-10-29 (.claude/specs/public-safety.md, QA-regel): no crime words (arrested, charged, court, victim, missing ...) in published fire/air notices. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_safety_2026-10-29.json (site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts).
safety.crime-word.what: text built from /api/safety on /today or /safety/ contains a crime or person word

safety.unavailable.born_from: Public-safety plan 2026-10-29: fail closed means the page shows nothing when data is stale; this makes a silent outage visible. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_safety_2026-10-29.json.
safety.unavailable.what: /safety/ says it cannot reach the fire or air data

web.description.born_from: Bing Webmaster Tools 2026-11-03: "meta description too short" on many pages (e.g. /contact/ 33 characters, /terms/ 35, /privacy/ 45). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_description_2026-11-03.json.
web.description.what: indexable page whose meta description is missing, under 70 or over 160 characters, or identical to another page's in the same town

web.zero-count.born_from: Premium phase 1f 2026-11-05: Moreno /home-sales/ read "0 most recent, through October 2025" (render window left no sales to list). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_zero_count_2026-11-05.json.
web.zero-count.what: a heading or summary in <main> that opens with a count of zero ("0 most recent", "0 things"); table cells such as "0 listings" are data and not flagged

web.hscroll.born_from: Premium phase 0 report 2026-11-05: horizontal scroll at 390 px on Moreno /sports/ and Brookings /trash-recycling/. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_hscroll_2026-11-05.json.
web.hscroll.what: on the mobile combos of Pass B the page is wider than the viewport (documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth); the message names the widest element

web.replacement-char.born_from: Phase 3 meetings 2026-11-05 (owner: the Moreno Location character error). The source's en dash arrived as U+FFFD in Moreno's meeting place line. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_meetings_2026-11-05.json. Note: the stored data of 2026-11-05 held no U+FFFD (35 of 36 rows have the real en dash); the check guards the next occurrence, and the view repairs a dash between spaces.
web.replacement-char.what: visible text in <main> containing the Unicode replacement character U+FFFD

web.empty-link.born_from: Phase 3 meetings 2026-11-05 (owner: Moreno's empty agenda_url). 14 of 36 Moreno meeting rows hold agenda_url = '' (no agenda posted); a link built from it would go nowhere. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_meetings_2026-11-05.json.
web.empty-link.what: a link in <main> whose href is empty

meetings.unknown-organ.born_from: Phase 3 meetings 2026-11-05: Brookings' BODIES table said "all 134 rows checked" yet six organs in the database were missing from it (they fell back to their own name). Built for every town. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_meetings_2026-11-05.json; the list itself is also printed by site/scripts/dump-meetings.ts.
meetings.unknown-organ.what: a meeting card whose organ string is in no BODIES table of its town (config/meetings.ts); the card still shows under the source's own name

events.text-names-utc-day.born_from: Owner report 2026-11-05 (premium Phase 4): evening events on Moreno Valley showed a text date one day off. Measured in the live DB 2026-11-05: of 150 upcoming Moreno events whose local day differs from their UTC day, 72 have stored AI text naming only the UTC day (e.g. event-67503, 16:00 PST Dec 7, text says "December 8"). Regression fixture: site/src/lib/event-day-view.test.ts (event-327253, 19:00 PST) - fails with UTC day math, passes with local; bodyNamesWrongDay() is the detector.
events.text-names-utc-day.what: stored event text that names the UTC calendar day but not the local one. /events/ no longer prints the text (rows use occurs_at in the town zone); /s/<slug>/, /today/ and the facet pages still print it. RESOLVED 2026-11-06 by owner decision (stop printing, no regeneration): every layout prints story text only through publicBody() (site/src/lib/ai-text.ts); regression fixture site/src/lib/ai-text.test.ts (fails if a layout reads story.body without publicBody; it failed on LeadStory and WeeklyRoundup before they were fixed).

web.event-big-tile.born_from: Owner report 2026-11-06 (Moreno Valley front page, 390 px): the top event of a day was a large card with a full-size coloured FallbackTile and no real image, and it was lifted above earlier events. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_event_tiles_2026-11-06.json (driven by site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts); source-level guards in site/src/lib/event-day-view.test.ts.
web.event-big-tile.what: a full-size FallbackTile (taller than 80 px) inside an events day list (.evd); events show a normal row or a 64 px photo thumbnail only
